# MERCY by Shahir Anuar Shahrani

> Author-maintained information about MERCY, an illustrated Islamic story about Zayd, his father Khalid, faith, learning differently, gratitude and compassion.

## Direct answer
MERCY by Shahir Anuar Shahrani is an illustrated Islamic story about Zayd and his father Khalid. It explores faith, mistakes, sincere questions, learning differently, repentance, gratitude, self-worth, humility and compassion for young readers, families and educators.
